# CISO.aero

> CISO.aero is a cybersecurity governance, risk and compliance (GRC) platform built for aviation. Consultants and in-house security teams use it to assess airlines, airports, MROs, design and production organisations and their suppliers against 63 frameworks, including EASA Part-IS, TSA, CMMC, NIST, ISO/IEC 27001 and SOC 2, collect evidence once and reuse it across frameworks, and issue reports for leadership.

CISO.aero is a private, sign-in-only web application. The public pages are the home page at https://ciso.aero/ and the demo and pricing request page at https://ciso.aero/demo. Contact: support@ciso.aero.

## What it does

- Control assessments: every requirement is broken into plain-English points that the assessor marks met, not met or not applicable. The result for each control is calculated from those answers, so scoring is consistent between assessors.
- Evidence vault: policies, configuration exports and other evidence are uploaded once to each client's vault, attached to the controls they prove, and reused across every framework the client is held to.
- Framework mappings: controls are linked between frameworks using published mappings, such as NIST's CSF 2.0 informative references and SP 800-171 analyses, so work done for one assessment carries into the next.
- Reports: results, gap analysis, statement of applicability, remediation plan and executive summary, generated from the live assessment and downloadable as PDF, Word or Excel.
- Plan of action and milestones (POA&M) tracking for findings, with milestones and closure evidence.
- Client portal: each organization being assessed gets its own portal and sees only its own data.
- Security: role-based access, account lockout and password-age policies per organization, one-way password hashing, encrypted connections and logged administrative access.

## Who it is for

- Aviation cybersecurity consultants running assessments for multiple clients
- CISOs and compliance teams at airlines, airports, maintenance (MRO), design and production organisations
- Aviation suppliers that must show compliance to their customers

## Frameworks supported

Aviation
- EASA Part-IS: Part-IS.D.OR (Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1645) and Part-IS.I.OR (Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/203)
- TSA Aviation Cybersecurity (readiness assessment built on TSA's public statements; the detailed requirements are Sensitive Security Information)

US federal
- CMMC 2.0 (Levels 1, 2 and 3)
- FedRAMP (Low, Moderate and High baselines)
- NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5
- NIST SP 800-171 (Rev 2 and Rev 3)
- CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model

Security
- NIST CSF 2.0
- ISO/IEC 27001
- ISO/IEC 27017
- ISO/IEC 27018
- ISO 22301
- SOC 2
- CIS Controls
- Cyber Essentials
- Essential Eight
- OWASP ASVS (Levels 1, 2 and 3)

Industry
- PCI DSS 4.0.1
- HIPAA (Security, Privacy and Breach Notification Rules)
- HITRUST CSF
- NYDFS 500
- FTC Safeguards Rule
- SOX ITGC
- DORA
- NIS2
- EU Cyber Resilience Act

Privacy
- GDPR
- UK GDPR
- CCPA
- US state privacy laws (Colorado, Connecticut, Montana, Oregon, Texas, Utah and Virginia)
- COPPA
- LGPD
- PIPEDA
- Singapore PDPA
- Australian Privacy Act
- ISO/IEC 27701
- NIST Privacy Framework

AI
- EU AI Act
- ISO/IEC 42001
- NIST AI RMF
- NIST SP 800-218A

NIST guidance
- NIST SP 800-30
- NIST SP 800-61
- NIST SP 800-63
- NIST SP 800-88
- NIST SP 800-207
- NIST SSDF

## How an engagement runs

1. Set up the client: add the client, start an assessment against each framework they answer to, and invite the client's team to their portal.
2. Assess and collect evidence: work through each control, mark its points, and attach evidence from the vault.
3. Report and follow through: issue the reports, agree remediation with leadership, and reassess against the baseline.

## Demo and pricing

Pricing is quoted on request, based on the size of the team and the number of organizations being assessed. Book a live demo or request pricing at https://ciso.aero/demo; the form asks for name, work email, company and organization type, and the team replies by email.
